metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: Sawérigading continues his journey and passes through many places, such as Kelling, Tessililu, and Taranati, and eventually he reaches the palojang, a deep hole that is connected to the underworld. Linrung Talaga appears to meet with Sawérigading. The latter descends into the underworld, where he encounters Wé Pinrakati, daughter of the sovereign of Malaka. He wishes to marry her but marrying the dead is impossible. Sawérigading returns to Luwuq. But shortly after he leaves for another journey with his wife Wé Panangngareng riding the bird Marempoba together.
